description: Erection of a single storey rear extension and a new basement level of house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: 474-IWA-EX-SP-00, Subterranean Construction Method Statement, Flood Risk Assessment, Design and Access Statement - received 28th June 2023, 474-IWA-E-03 Rev. A, 474-IWA-ZZ-S-01 Rev. A, 474-IWA-P-00 Rev. A - received 25th August 2023.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.

Condition : 4 - The basement light well hereby approved shall be installed with a 
metal grille and not with the glazed finish shown on the drawings.
Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.

Condition : 5 - The basement shall at no time be used or occupied as a separate 
residential dwelling independent of the main house, and shall not 
contain bedrooms or be used as sleeping accommodation. 
Reasons: To ensure the use of the building does not prejudice the 
amenities of adjacent neighbours and to minimise flood risk.

Condition : 6 - Before commencement of works, the developer shall carry out a 
survey of the condition of the highway and footway within 20 metres 
of the site to establish any pre-existing damage of the pavement and 
carriageway and shall submit the same to the Local Highways 
Authority for their written approval. 
During works, an appropriate wheel-washing system shall be 
operated to remove mud, stones and other extraneous materials 
from vehicle wheels and chassis? leaving the site, and all departing 
loads shall be fully covered to ensure no material is deposited on the 
highway. Waste water discharged from the wheel wash shall be 
stored and disposed of on site and not discharged into the public 
sewer unless soil, stones and any suspended material have first 
been removed.
The developer shall ensure that no dust or other debris is carried on 
to adjoining properties in accordance with the guidance at 
https://www.london.gov.uk/file/18750/download?token=zV3ZKTpP.
Site lighting shall be designed, positioned and directed so as not to 
unnecessarily intrude on passing drivers or direct light into any 
neighbouring windows in accordance with the guidance provided by 
the Institute of Lighting Engineers Guidance Note: For The 
Reduction Of Obtrusive Light 2021.
All vehicle arrivals and departures shall be supervised and the 
condition of the highway examined immediately afterwards. Any 
materials shed from the vehicle during such movement shall be 
immediately removed from the highway, and returned to site or 
carted away for disposal and shall not be washed into the surface 
water drainage system.
An appropriate site hoarding shall be erected and choice of tools 
used to minimise any noise, dust and air pollution resulting from the 
basement excavation and construction works hereby approved. All 
excavated materials shall also be appropriately and effectively 
covered at all times to prevent dust and air pollution, stored fully 
within the site and

Condition : 7 - The Construction Method Statement submitted as part of the 
planning application hereby approved shall be fully adhered to 
throughout the construction process. 
Reason: To protect public safety and neighbour living conditions.

Condition : 8 - All contractors involved in the excavation and construction of the 
basement extension and front lightwell hereby approved shall be 
members of the Considerate Constructors' Scheme. 
Reason: To protect public health and safety, highway safety, 
neighbour living conditions and the quality of the local environment, 
and manage local parking demand.
